tagline: Turn Lovable apps into verified, live products
description: ClawKit for Lovable is an OpenClaw plugin that helps makers plan, rescue, verify, refactor, publish, and hand off Lovable.dev projects without wasting credits. Use Lovable for fast UI/product work, then let OpenClaw handle GitHub, tests, visual QA, publish readiness, dashboards, client reports, and maintainable code.
makerFirstComment:
Hey Product Hunt,

I built ClawKit for Lovable for the moment many Lovable.dev users hit after the first exciting demo: the UI looks promising, but the app still needs verification, GitHub discipline, clean code, publish confidence, and a sane handoff.

ClawKit turns Lovable.dev into one specialist tool inside an OpenClaw workflow:

- Plan before spending Lovable credits
- Lint prompts so they do not ask Lovable to solve backend/security/refactor work
- Rescue blank, stale, broken, or invisible Lovable changes
- Verify real browser and screenshot results
- Hand off to GitHub as source of truth
- Refactor and harden generated code
- Publish only after approval, access checks, and live URL verification
- Generate dashboards and client handoff reports

The big idea: use Lovable.dev for speed and product shape, then use OpenClaw for correctness, maintainability, publishing, and delivery.

I would love feedback from Lovable users, vibe coders, agencies, and OpenClaw builders: where should ClawKit draw the line between prompting Lovable again and fixing the project directly in code?
